title: Invoice Data Entry
summary: Capture invoice fields, validate required information, and enter approved records into the finance system.
workflow: The workflow monitors an invoice inbox, extracts key fields, checks supplier and purchase-order rules, and sends exceptions to a person before posting valid records.
outcome: Shorter processing time, more consistent data entry, and a clear exception queue for the finance team.

title: Bank Reconciliation Assistant
summary: Match bank transactions with ledger records and highlight unresolved differences for review.
workflow: Transaction files are downloaded, normalized, and compared with ledger entries using amount, date, and reference rules. Unmatched items are grouped for review.
outcome: Faster close activities and better visibility into missing, duplicated, or incorrectly classified transactions.

title: Expense Report Audit
summary: Review submitted expenses against policy limits, receipt requirements, and duplicate-payment rules.
workflow: Each report is checked for receipts, spending thresholds, dates, categories, and duplicate amounts. Compliant reports continue; exceptions receive a clear reason code.
outcome: More consistent policy enforcement and less time spent on routine expense checks.

title: Employee Onboarding Coordinator
summary: Create accounts, prepare documents, notify teams, and track onboarding tasks from one approved request.
workflow: An approved hire record starts role-based tasks for HR, IT, facilities, and the hiring manager. Status updates are collected into one onboarding checklist.
outcome: A consistent first-day experience with fewer missed access requests and clearer task ownership.

title: Leave Balance Responder
summary: Answer routine leave-balance questions with current data and route policy exceptions to HR.
workflow: The employee request is matched to a verified profile, the current balance is retrieved, and a standard response is prepared with links to the leave policy.
outcome: Faster answers for employees and fewer repetitive lookups for the HR team.

title: Interview Scheduling
summary: Coordinate candidate and interviewer availability, send invitations, and record the confirmed time.
workflow: Available interview windows are gathered, filtered for the required panel, offered to the candidate, and converted into calendar invitations after confirmation.
outcome: Less scheduling email, quicker interview cycles, and fewer calendar conflicts.

title: Inventory Reorder Alerts
summary: Monitor stock levels and create prioritized reorder alerts using demand and lead-time rules.
workflow: Current stock, open orders, expected demand, and supplier lead time are compared. Items below their calculated threshold are added to a buyer review list.
outcome: Earlier shortage warnings and more consistent replenishment decisions.

title: Sales Order Validation
summary: Check new orders for customer, product, pricing, address, and credit-rule issues before fulfillment.
workflow: Incoming orders are compared with customer master data, current price lists, product availability, address standards, and credit status before release.
outcome: Fewer order corrections, cleaner fulfillment handoffs, and reduced delay from preventable data issues.

title: Quality Report Builder
summary: Combine inspection results, calculate quality indicators, and distribute a standardized operations report.
workflow: Inspection files are consolidated, checked for missing values, summarized by product and location, and formatted into a consistent report for distribution.
outcome: Reliable weekly reporting with less copying, formatting, and manual calculation.

title: Service Ticket Triage
summary: Classify incoming requests, set priority, suggest a response, and route each ticket to the right queue.
workflow: Ticket subject, description, customer tier, and product are evaluated against routing rules. Common requests receive a suggested response for an agent to review.
outcome: Faster first response, more consistent routing, and less time spent moving tickets between teams.

title: Proactive Order Updates
summary: Send customers timely status messages when an order is confirmed, delayed, shipped, or delivered.
workflow: Order-status changes trigger approved message templates. Customer preferences determine the channel, while unusual delivery issues create an agent task.
outcome: Fewer status inquiries and a more transparent customer experience.

title: Lead Data Enrichment
summary: Standardize new lead records, fill approved company details, remove duplicates, and assign ownership.
workflow: New records are cleaned, compared for duplicates, enriched from approved sources, scored with business rules, and assigned by territory and segment.
outcome: Cleaner CRM data and faster follow-up with qualified prospects.

title: Contract Renewal Reminders
summary: Identify upcoming renewals, prepare account context, and schedule coordinated customer follow-up.
workflow: Contracts approaching their notice window are grouped by owner. Each reminder includes value, products, open issues, and the next recommended action.
outcome: Earlier renewal conversations and fewer missed notice dates.

title: User Access Review
summary: Prepare application-access evidence, collect manager decisions, and track removal actions for periodic reviews.
workflow: Current users and roles are collected by application, mapped to managers, and sent for review. Denied or expired access creates traceable removal tasks.
outcome: More complete access reviews with a consistent decision trail and fewer manual spreadsheets.

title: System Health Digest
summary: Consolidate monitoring alerts, remove duplicates, calculate service indicators, and publish a daily digest.
workflow: Alerts from approved monitoring sources are normalized, grouped by service, and summarized with uptime and incident status before a daily team update is posted.
outcome: A clearer operational picture with less alert copying and less noise for support teams.
